context: Kenji helps Yuki with an electronic form.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: tech help; vocabulary (電子/受ける/回答/いただく/いれ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: この電子書類、どう書くんですか?
lines.en: How do I fill in this electronic document?
lines.style: slightly stuck office woman voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: まず、質問への回答を入れて下さい。
lines.en: First, enter your answers to the questions.
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 回答を入れたら、どうなりますか?
lines.en: What happens after I enter the answers?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 電子で、すぐ受け付けられます。
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 確認は、メールで受けるんですか?
lines.en: Do I receive confirmation by email?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、確認のメールをいただけます。
lines.en: Yes, you'll receive a confirmation email.
lines.style: reassuring office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 電子の回答、便利ですね。
lines.style: satisfied office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 空欄も、忘れずに入れて下さいね。
lines.en: Don't forget to fill the blanks too.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
